changeSet.sql: -- 初始化向量表，创建示例数据 INSERT INTO ai_vector_store_4096 (vector_id, kb_id, document_id, chunk_id, collection_name, embedding, content, metadata) VALUES ('init-vector-1', 1, 1, 1, 'default', (SELECT array_agg(random() - 0.5)::vector(4096) FROM generate_series(1, 4096)), '这是一个示例向量内容，用于测试向量搜索功能', '{"source": "initialization", "type": "test"}'::jsonb), ('init-vector-2', 1, 1, 2, 'default', (SELECT array_agg(random() - 0.5)::vector(4096) FROM generate_series(1, 4096)), '这是另一个示例向量内容，用于测试向量搜索功能', '{"source": "initialization", "type": "test"}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (vector_id) DO NOTHING;

rollback.sql: -- 回滚初始化数据 DELETE FROM ai_vector_store_4096 WHERE vector_id IN ('init-vector-1', 'init-vector-2');
